paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s boys beat Baldwyn 73–41 Tuesday to finish the Booneville Thanksgiving Tournament with two wins in as many days. The Warriors scored their most points in six games this season and left Booneville with a 5–1 record.

The 32-point win extended Pontotoc’s winning streak to four. It began with a 68–34 home win over Louisville, followed by a 59–54 road win at Tupelo. The Warriors opened the Booneville tournament Monday by beating Florence of Alabama 68–53.
Baldwyn had won its opener by 34 points the night before, beating Thrasher 58–24. Tuesday’s loss evened the Bearcats’ record at 1–1. They are scheduled for a rematch at Thrasher on Dec. 3.

Pontotoc’s next opponent is Grissom of Huntsville, Alabama. The teams are scheduled for 11:30 a.m. Friday, Nov. 27, at the Lighthouse Classic in Corinth. The Warriors return home to face Houston on Tuesday, Dec. 1, at 7:15 p.m.
